insertion: respect of supply of goods or services
referred to in subsection (1) of section
7  is  not  received  in  foreign  currency
through a bank in Sri Lanka licenced
under the Banking Act, No. 30 of 1988
within a period of six months from the
end  of  the  taxable  period  of  which
such  exportation  has  taken  place  or
supply of such service is provided, as
the case may be, where it is proved to
General that such goods are exported
or the services are performed, the rate
specified in section 2 shall not apply
on such supply of goods or services.”.
